## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Tech is the clear laggard while most cyclicals and defensives are ABOVE TREND; Leadership: Broad (Top 5 span 5 sectors).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Staples lead: WMT (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +11.26%) ABOVE TREND, CVS (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +2.32%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare also leading: LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -3.15% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +6.29%) CORRECTION. Industrials/Financials show patchy performance but remain net positive on 1W.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +2.60%) ABOVE TREND, VZ (1W: +7.54% | 1M: -5.89%) RECOVERY, SBUX (1W: +7.46% | 1M: +0.88%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5); style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CEG (1W: -8.96% | 1M: +3.26%) CORRECTION, AVGO (1W: -9.07% | 1M: -5.17%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -9.29% | 1M: -2.21%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -9.31% | 1M: -14.53%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -11.01% | 1M: +5.55%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in Technology.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +2.60%) ABOVE TREND, VZ (1W: +7.54% | 1M: -5.89%) RECOVERY, TMUS (1W: +7.08% | 1M: -4.42%) RECOVERY — watch recovery candidates for follow-through versus short-term reversals.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is under pressure with notable chip and software names BELOW TREND: NVDA (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -9.31% | 1M: -14.53%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -9.07% | 1M: -5.17%) BELOW TREND while pockets like ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND and INTU (1W: +7.40% | 1M: +4.32%) ABOVE TREND show dispersion; sector breadth: negative on 1W.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials mostly resilient on 1W with payments lead: V (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +8.83%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +4.80% | 1M: +9.30%) ABOVE TREND; banking names show mixed momentum and some recovery candidates like JPM (1W: +2.02% | 1M: -2.26%) RECOVERY.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare constructive: UNH (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, MDT (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +2.97%) ABOVE TREND; watch JNJ (1W: -2.25% | 1M: -5.43%) BELOW TREND where positive headlines contrast with price.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals and defensive earnings names showing confirmed strength (ACN ABOVE TREND, COP ABOVE TREND, UNH ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to concentrated tech weakness (NVDA BELOW TREND, ORCL BELOW TREND). Style: Mixed / no clear leadership; be selective given CAUTION regime and broad but shallow leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -9.31% | 1M: -14.53%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -14.18% | 1M: -17.42%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (COP ABOVE TREND, XOM ABOVE TREND) — sector strength on 1W; Healthcare (UNH, LLY) also constructive. BEARISH: Technology (broad selling in semis & software) — watch for further breadth deterioration.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA resistance area to test near recent swing highs (NVDA (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND) as confirmation for trend break; ACN support breakout continuation (ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND) to signal durable leadership; ORCL downside momentum (ORCL (1W: -9.31% | 1M: -14.53%) BELOW TREND) to warn of further tech flow.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+75): Johnson & Johnson raised sales outlook; JNJ (1W: -2.25% | 1M: -5.43%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from price. LLY (+75): EU backing for weight-loss pill; LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming price. ASML (+65): Equipment narrative supporting AI supply chain; ASML (use existing SP100 mapping) showing bullish sentiment that aligns with chip-equipment strength in pockets.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
MSFT (-50): Regulatory headline; MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +6.29%) CORRECTION — news confirms near-term softness. AMZN (-50): FDA warning; AMZN (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -0.47%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming weakness. INTC (-45): Competitive/packaging pressure; INTC (1W: -14.18% | 1M: -17.42%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, Style mixed / no clear leadership. ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: Technology breadth deterioration — NVDA (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND and sentiment/price divergences in JNJ (+75) vs JNJ (1W: -2.25% | 1M: -5.43%) BELOW TREND require monitoring.
